name: Update Issue
description: Updates an issue. A transition may be applied and issue properties updated as part of the edit. [See the documentation](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/rest/v3/api-group-issues/#api-rest-api-3-issue-issueidorkey-put)

configurable_props.name: properties
configurable_props.label: Properties
configurable_props.description: Details of issue properties to be added or updated. Please provide an array of objects with keys and values.

configurable_props.name: update
configurable_props.label: Update
configurable_props.description: A Map containing the field name and a list of operations to perform on the issue screen field. Note that fields included here cannot be included in `fields`.

configurable_props.name: additionalProperties
configurable_props.label: Additional properties
configurable_props.description: Extra properties of any type may be provided to this object

configurable_props.name: issueIdOrKey
configurable_props.label: Issue ID or Key
configurable_props.description: The ID or key of an issue

configurable_props.name: issueTypeId
configurable_props.label: Issue Type
configurable_props.description: An ID identifying the type of issue. [Check the API docs](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/rest/v3/#api-rest-api-3-issue-post) to see available options

configurable_props.name: notifyUsers
configurable_props.label: Notify Users
configurable_props.description: Whether a notification email about the issue update is sent to all watchers. To disable the notification, administer Jira or administer project permissions are required. If the user doesn't have the necessary permission the request is ignored.

configurable_props.name: overrideScreenSecurity
configurable_props.label: Override Screen Security
configurable_props.description: Whether screen security should be overridden to enable hidden fields to be edited. Available to Connect app users with admin permissions.

configurable_props.name: overrideEditableFlag
configurable_props.label: Override Editable Flag
configurable_props.description: Whether screen security should be overridden to enable uneditable fields to be edited. Available to Connect app users with admin permissions.

configurable_props.name: transitionId
configurable_props.label: Transition ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the issue transition. Retrieving options requires a static `issueIdOrKey`. Required when specifying a transition to undertake.
